purpose: Defines the abstraction of forge's four wrapper SKILLs that delegate rule/spec document search and index updates to backends: skill list, arguments, output contract, and SKILL contract.
summary: Overview: forge delegates document search and index updates to doc-link or doc-db via four wrapper SKILLs
Skill list: query-db-rules, query-db-specs, update-db-rules, update-db-specs with fixed categories
Query flow: resolve backend order, use the first available backend, explicit error if none, no grep fallback
Query output contract: Required documents path list built by script, common across backends
Query SKILL contract: inherited (non-fork) search skill, allowed tools, args limited to keywords and short task text
Update flow: explicit --backend skips selection and fails rather than switching; otherwise ordered selection
Desired-state rule: .doc_structure.yaml is the source of truth; paths not included are removed from the index
Precondition: at least one backend must be available, judged by capability not version
Ownership boundary: backend selection and per-backend paths belong to DES-057
Test map: doc structure resolution, lint checks for query skill wiring and phrases, backend tests, wrapper tests
tasks: Designing or changing the query-db/update-db wrapper SKILLs
Implementing or modifying wrapper scripts for document search
Calling query-db-rules or query-db-specs from other forge skills
Updating document search indexes after editing rules or specs
Reviewing the query SKILL contract and allowed-tools settings
Adding or changing lint and tests for query skill wiring
Investigating backend selection and index preparation delegation behavior
title: DES-001 文書検索ラッパー（forge → 文書検索 backend）設計書
